maximum_invasive_thickness_mm.description: Maximum thickness of invasive tumour from muscularis mucosae in mm; leave empty if not dictated.

invasive_tumour_width_mm.description: Width of invasive tumour in mm; leave empty if not dictated.

haggitt_level.description: Haggitt level for a polypoid tumour; leave empty if not applicable or not dictated.

kikuchi_level.description: Kikuchi level for a sessile or flat tumour; leave empty if not applicable or not dictated.

peripheral_margin.description: Carcinoma involvement of peripheral margin; required for completion and left visible if not dictated.

deep_margin.description: Carcinoma involvement of deep margin; required for completion and left visible if not dictated.

carcinoma_to_deep_margin_mm.description: Histological measurement from carcinoma to nearest deep excision margin in mm; leave empty if not dictated.

complete_resection_over_1mm.description: Whether carcinoma is completely resected by more than 1 mm at all margins; leave empty if not dictated.

tumour_block.description: Representative tumour block; leave empty if not dictated.
